content: Customer Pranav Mishra requested assistance with home insurance for his newly moved-into residence. Insurance agent Neha Kapoor congratulated the customer and requested the new address to proceed. The customer provided the address as '1456 Oakwood Apartments, near city center'. The agent requested clarification on the specific street name or zip code to ensure the address is accurate and informed the customer that a form would be sent to finalize the policy details.

action_items: Customer to confirm complete address including street name or zip code
Agent to send policy details form to customer
